assumptions: Assumed 2,300 total square feet (1,100 ground + 1,200 basement)
Assumed ~70 seats for a 2,300 sq ft cocktail bar
Assumed ~12 employees for a full-service bar with food and entertainment
Assumed full kitchen inherited from the restaurant use
Assumed tenant improvements for bar conversion (bar build-out, sound/lighting systems)
Assumed 'nighttime entertainment' means live entertainment with amplified sound requiring a Place of Entertainment permit
Assumed hours past midnight but closing before 2 am (no Extended Hours permit needed)
Assumed no dancing (not stated; POE can cover live music/DJs without dancing)
Assumed exterior signage will be installed or updated
Assumed the Type 47 license is held at this address and will be replaced by acquiring a Type 48
